title: Thin Extrude of an open quarter arc, wall centred on the curve (2 mm), 5 high

expect.note: Center: 1 mm each side of the R10 arc, a quarter ring from R9 to R11: (121 - 81) pi / 4 = 10 pi mm^2, 5 high = 50 pi. The ends are cut square to the arc (on the X and Y axes). Faces: 2 round, 2 ends, top, bottom.
